summary: You already have a consultation form, before and after galleries and a payment plan, but missing reviews and leftover template text hold the page back.

findings.problem: No patient reviews or testimonials appear anywhere on the page.
findings.cost: High value implant and All on 4 patients check reviews before they call.
findings.fix: A review wall pulled from Google.

findings.problem: Our Services, For Patients and the footer address link point to #, and two header phone links have no visible text.
findings.cost: Dead links and a blank phone link lose enquiries from mobile users.
findings.fix: Working menu and clear click to call.

findings.problem: Leftover template text appears: Flyout Menu, Main Menu, Scroll to Top, and image titles from Home 1 to Home 22. The menu repeats three times.
findings.cost: Template leftovers look unfinished on a specialist site.
findings.fix: Clean markup and proper image text.

findings.problem: Copy is thin (offers solutions for various dental concerns), the Greek origin of prosthodontics looks incorrect, buttons say Learn More and Book Now, and there is no WhatsApp.
findings.cost: Vague copy gives patients no reason to pick you.
findings.fix: Specific outcomes, proofread facts and a WhatsApp button.

redesign: Google reviews beside your results galleries for each treatment.
Specific, accurate copy and WhatsApp plus a simple booking path.
